definitions.explanation: Rice from which the bran and germ have been milled away, leaving the white grain eaten as ordinary cooked rice.

examples.japanese: {精白米|せいはくまい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{炊|た}く→炊く：02127_taku⟧。
{精白米|せいはくまい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{玄米|げんまい}→玄米：06100_genmai⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧⟦{栄養|えいよう}→栄養：01882_eiyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{少|すく}ない→少ない：01136_sukunai⟧。
examples.english: Polished rice is less nutritious than brown rice.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{普段|ふだん}→普段：00041_fudan⟧⟦ご{飯|はん}→ご飯：00776_gohan⟧⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{食|た}べている→食べる：00396_taberu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦ほとんど→ほとんど：00847_hotondo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{精白米|せいはくまい}だ。
examples.english: Most of the rice people in Japan eat every day is polished white rice.

notes:
USAGE:
A technical word, seen on rice bags and in nutrition writing. In everyday speech people say ⟦{白米|はくまい}→白米：06101_hakumai⟧, or simply お⟦{米|こめ}→米：01323_kome⟧ or ⟦ご{飯|はん}→ご飯：00776_gohan⟧.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{白米|はくまい}→白米：06101_hakumai⟧: white rice (the common word)
- ⟦{玄米|げんまい}→玄米：06100_genmai⟧: brown rice
- ⟦{精米|せいまい}→精米：06615_seimai⟧: rice polishing; polished rice
